h0.text: Trump says 99.99%. Switzerland checked the math.

n0.text: Switzerland mourns those who were killed, and respects those who defend others.

n1.text: We also checked the arithmetic: 3 out of about 10,500 is 99.97 percent.

n2.text: In Switzerland, the last two decimals are considered important.

v0.text: Geneva is home to the Red Cross and the Geneva Conventions.

v1.text: Here, we count differently: every single one matters.

v2.text: That is why we never round up.
